builds.name: Leveling — Frost (Ice Lance at 20, Shatter at 25, Ice Barrier at 40)
builds.summary: Classic Frost leveling was Frostbolt/Ice Shards early, Shatter at 30, Ice Block at 34 and Ice Barrier at 43. Forever pulls the burst forward: Ice Lance arrives at 20 (Frost Nova -> step back -> Ice Lance, 4x damage on a Frozen target and ~60% of all leveling damage in the fight lab), Shatter at 25-27, Fingers of Frost at 30, Ice Block at 32 and Ice Barrier at 40. Ends in the Forever Fingers of Frost raid build (12/0/39) — no respec.

core.why: Still 5/5 but no longer the opening points: the fight lab values it at ~3% per kill once Ice Lance carries the damage, so it comes at 44-48 after Ice Barrier.
Unchanged +100% Frost crit damage.
New at 20: instant, 300% damage on Frozen targets — Frost Nova -> Ice Lance replaces the Classic Nova -> Frostbolt burst and needs no cast.
The 16-point talent, taken at 32 after Shatter and Fingers of Frost: the sim has no bad pulls to block, and Shatter is worth ~20% per kill.
3 ranks for est. +51% crit vs. Frozen — 2 points cheaper than Classic.
New: chills grant a 'Frozen' cast (est. 30% at 2/2) — Shatter-crit Frostbolts on mobs that are not novaed.
Random freezes from chills (est. 15%) feed Shatter and Ice Lance; more valuable in Forever than in Classic.
Second Ice Block/Nova; Ice Barrier prerequisite (moved to tier 5).
Level-40 milestone; requires Cold Snap now.
Hit; 5 ranks now, so it is spread across 37-47 rather than taken in one go.

flex.why: Winter's Chill only buffs Frostbolt/Ice Lance crit in Forever and its stack count is unclear; AoE grinders should take Improved Blizzard/Permafrost here instead and respec at 60.
Mana vs. longer slows.

notes: Rotation: Frostbolt -> Frost Nova when the mob reaches you -> Ice Lance (x2 if Fingers of Frost procs) -> Frostbolt; Cone of Cold to re-snare.
Arcane Concentration and the Arcane fillers are left for 49-60 because nothing in Arcane speeds up a kill.

Order revised 2026-09-26 from the fight lab (fightlab/candidates/cand-hand-revised.json raced against the old order with the same seeds): Elemental Precision, Frostbite and Ice Shards first so that Ice Lance lands at 20 and Shatter at 25-27 — 7% faster per kill at 20, 13% at 25, 6% at 30, the same from 40 on.
